title: Poster for a Risograph demo
lede: A two-color poster that announces a Risograph demonstration, printed in red and blue with hand-drawn lettering and a drawing of the machine.
summary: Two-color red and blue riso poster for a Risograph demo, with hand lettering.

creator.name: Unknown. The Flickr uploader, lee leblanc, does not say who designed it.

evidence.note: Viewed the 1024 × 765 px Flickr “large” file, a photograph of two copies taped to a wall. The poster names the event (“Monday Nov 30, 6–7 pm”) but not the venue or designer.

styles.note: Partial fit: two spot inks and hand lettering, but little overprint or grain is visible at this size.

context: Posted on Flickr under CC BY 2.0 with the description “see what it can do!”. The designer is not named.
observed: Only two inks appear: a warm red for the title, the machine drawing, and one line, and a blue for the date and script words.
“Magic! Mystery Delight!” is written in blue script over the red drawing of the duplicator.
The paper is white, and both copies look the same, as in a short duplicator run.
interpretation: The poster advertises the machine with its own look: two drums, hand-drawn type, and a drawing of the duplicator.
borrow: Let a script word in the second ink cross a drawing in the first ink.

rights.statement: Photo posted CC BY 2.0 by lee leblanc. The designer is not named, so the poster is treated as in copyright. Link only.
